name: site-inventory
title: Hazardous substances inventory working draft
for_each: select id,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Site and access
sections.note: Human review required. Keep confirmed inventory and actual current safety sheets accessible after evacuation. This working draft is not a safety certificate.

sections.title: Declared maxima and recorded quantities
sections.sql: select chemical,unit,coalesce(maximum_quantity::text,'not declared') as maximum_quantity,onsite_quantity,waste_quantity from v_site_inventory where site_id=$1 order by chemical

sections.title: Locations and safety references
sections.note: A reference is not a copy of the safety sheet. Confirm actual access and current information.
sections.sql: select chemical,coalesce(locations,'no active containers recorded') as locations,case when not un_reviewed then 'not reviewed' when un_number is null then 'none, reviewed' else un_number end as un_number,coalesce(storage_notes,'not recorded') as storage_notes,coalesce(sds_reference,'not recorded') as safety_sheet from v_site_inventory where site_id=$1 order by chemical

sections.title: Outstanding record checks
sections.sql: select c.record,c.rule,c.issue from v_compliance c join sites s on s.code=c.site where s.id=$1 order by c.record,c.rule

name: stocktake-sheet
title: Physical stocktake working sheet
for_each: select id,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Count and record discrepancies
sections.note: Print for counting. Blank observed quantity and initials are intentional. Update the database using log-stock after the physical check.
sections.sql: select c.code,ch.name as chemical,l.name as location,c.quantity as recorded_quantity,ch.unit,'' as observed_quantity,'' as initials from containers c join chemicals ch on ch.id=c.chemical_id join locations l on l.id=c.location_id where l.site_id=$1 and c.state<>'removed' order by l.name,c.code

name: waste-handover
title: Waste collection handover working draft
for_each: select id,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Awaiting collection
sections.note: Not a transport document or classification. A competent person and the collection provider verify classification and disposal requirements. Nothing is sent.
sections.sql: select c.code,ch.name as chemical,c.quantity,ch.unit,l.name as location,c.owner from containers c join chemicals ch on ch.id=c.chemical_id join locations l on l.id=c.location_id where l.site_id=$1 and c.state='waste' order by c.code
